slides.title: *Domain* vs *Data element*
slides.subtitle: Explain it clearly in 30 seconds. Swipe.

slides.heading: *Domain* = technical
slides.body:
Defines how the value is stored: data type, length, decimals.

Also fixed values, value table and conversion routine (like ALPHA).

slides.heading: *Data element* = meaning
slides.body:
Defines what the field means: field labels, F1 documentation, search help.

It points to a domain (or a built-in type) for the technical details.

slides.heading: Real example: *KUNNR*
slides.code:
Table field  KNA1-KUNNR
  Data element  KUNNR
    Labels: "Customer"
  Domain        KUNNR
    CHAR 10
    Conversion   ALPHA
slides.note: One domain can be reused by many data elements with different labels.

slides.heading: How to *answer it*
items: Give the one-line difference - Domain is technical, data element is semantic
Name what each holds - Type and length vs labels and F1 help
Add a real example - KUNNR with ALPHA conversion

posts.caption:
"What is the difference between a domain and a data element?"

A simple way to answer:
- Domain: the technical side. Data type, length, decimals, fixed values, conversion routine.
- Data element: the meaning. Field labels, F1 documentation, search help. It refers to a domain.

Then give a real example, such as KUNNR with its ALPHA conversion. That one detail shows you have actually worked in SE11.

slides.title: steps to find *any error's* source
slides.voiceover: कोई भी error message कहाँ से आ रहा है? तीन steps में पता करो।
slides.spoken: Koi bhi error message kahan se aa raha hai? Teen steps mein pata karo.

slides.title: Type */h* and press Enter
slides.voiceover: Command field में slash h type करो, Enter दबाओ।
slides.spoken: Command field mein slash h type karo, Enter dabao.

slides.title: Breakpoint at *MESSAGE*
slides.voiceover: Breakpoint at statement में MESSAGE लिखो।
slides.spoken: Breakpoint at statement mein MESSAGE likho.

slides.title: Press *F8*
slides.body: The debugger stops on the exact line.
slides.voiceover: F8 दबाओ। Debugger ठीक उसी line पर रुकेगा।
slides.spoken: F8 dabao. Debugger theek usi line par rukega.

posts.caption:
A user reports an error, and you have no idea which line of code raised it.

The fastest way to find out:
1. Type /h in the command field and press Enter
2. Repeat the action to open the debugger
3. Breakpoints > Breakpoint at Statement > MESSAGE
4. Press F8. The debugger stops at the exact line.

Look at the condition above that line. That is usually your root cause.

Save this for your next production issue.
